text: Evaluation and Admission Procedures 1. Application Review Applications submitted with all the information and materials correct and completed will be reviewed by Beihang University. 2. Integrative Test Applicants who have passed the Application Review will be admitted to the integrative test. The method and time of the integrative test will be informed in advance. 3. Pre-admission Notice 4. Official Admission Result The admission decision is based on a comprehensive evaluation of the application review and integrative test. Tuition Fee: RMB 30,000 Yuan /Yr. Insurance:RMB3,200 Yuan /4 Yr. Study Period: 4 Years. The maximum period is 6 years Accommodation International Students Dormitory, double room with a bathroom: 750 Yuan/Month, per bed* * Accommodation fees may be adjusted. Bills of water and electricity are not included.
